blocks.text: 🪝 Gross GST Collections Surge 15.4% to ₹2.11 Trillion in July 2026. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: GST collections serve as India's primary high-frequency indicator of indirect tax efficiency and macroeconomic health.
Growth was driven primarily by higher mop-up from **domestic transactions** as well as **import of goods**.
Represents one of the highest monthly gross GST collection figures recorded.
Do not confuse Gross GST collection (before refunds) with Net GST collection (tax retained post-refunds).
